Game Overview

In Meteorite Assult, the core idea is straightforward: pilot your spaceship through a chaotic asteroid field in Meteorite Assault. Dodge meteorites with precision, collect shining coins, and unlock unique ships with strategic advantages. With ever-increasing scores and a global leaderboard, every second is a race for survival. Can you conquer the cosmic chaos?
